description: All Cloud Run service platform request-log 5xx. Service is inherited from monitored resource. Unknown route/action remain empty; only Gemini is classified.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="based-hardware" AND logName="projects/based-hardware/logs/run.googleapis.com%2Frequests" AND httpRequest.status >= 500 AND httpRequest.status < 600

labels.description: Only fixed Gemini route family; empty means unclassified, not a template for other paths.
Four fixed Gemini actions or empty; never model, URL, ID or arbitrary action.
